title: National registration of health practitioners (South Australia)
summary: The Health Practitioner Regulation National Law replaced state registration boards in South Australia, giving practitioners one national registration.

assessment.summary: One national registration for health practitioners replaced separate state boards, so a registered nurse, doctor or other practitioner can work in any state. A large gain for mobility in one of the biggest workforces.

marks.reason: Removes the need to re-register when moving between states, for hundreds of thousands of practitioners.
One national scheme and standards replaced separate state and territory boards.
